name: A board game, pieces missing
vera_note: A trading game, the kind with little wooden tokens and cards you shuffle between turns. Six wooden figures are missing — someone penciled replacements on small squares of paper and left them inside the box with a rubber band around the stack. The pencilled tokens have names: Sam, Petra, Bee, Dav, the kids, Hound. Hound is not a board game token name. They played with a dog at the table. The rules pamphlet has handwritten house rules added in red on the last page. One rule: 'no one loses their last card.'
